csv_scope_of_work: The County of Westchester (the County ), acting by and through its Department of Parks, Recreation and Conservation ( Parks ), is requesting proposals from qualified planning, landscaping architecture, and environmental consulting firms (or teams) to prepare an update to the County s Parks and Recreation Master Plan ( Master Plan ).

title: Consultant for Parks & Recreation Master Plan
short_description: Consulting services to update Westchester County's parks and recreation master plan.
project_scope: Update of the County Parks and Recreation Master Plan for Westchester County. The scope is planning-focused and includes parks, recreation, landscape architecture, land use planning, environmental planning/design, and urban studies/planning/design. No specific building, bridge, span, or gross floor area is stated.
services: Master planning, planning consultancy, landscape architecture, environmental consulting, land use planning, urban planning, and architecture services.
relevance_explanation:
- Pure master planning and parks planning project.
- No bridge, building, roof, stadium, or special structural design scope identified.
- Falls under urban/open space planning and landscape planning, which are not target areas for sbp.
- No structural complexity, long-span elements, or engineering design component described.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the tender notice. The notice concerns preparation of a master plan only, with no defined construction measures, quantities, or project budget from which a realistic construction cost estimate could be derived.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. As this is a planning/master planning consultancy without a defined structural engineering scope, an sbp-specific fee cannot be realistically estimated from the available information.
references_qualifications: Qualified planning, landscape architecture, and environmental consulting firms or teams are requested. No specific minimum number or type of reference projects is stated in the notice excerpt.
